bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
db=deploy-postgres-1
test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 70
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 71
sql="WITH eligible AS (
 SELECT q.edit_id FROM room_status_message_edits q
 JOIN room_source_events e ON e.event_id=q.room_event_id
 JOIN room_posts r ON r.room_id=e.room_id
 JOIN posting_deliveries d ON d.delivery_id=q.delivery_id
 JOIN posting_topics t ON t.topic_id=d.posting_topic_id
 WHERE q.state='needs_reconcile'
 AND e.kind='finished' AND e.state='applied' AND r.status='finished'
 AND d.status='sent' AND d.telegram_message_id IS NOT NULL AND d.rendered_text IS NOT NULL
 AND t.enabled=TRUE AND t.purpose IN ('room','announcement')
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM room_status_message_edits s WHERE s.delivery_id=q.delivery_id AND s.state='sending')
 AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT feature) FROM gaybbs_feature_release_gates
 WHERE feature IN ('room','announcement') AND enabled=TRUE
 AND length(source_commit)=40 AND length(trim(ci_evidence))>0
 AND length(trim(gserver_runtime_evidence))>0 AND length(trim(telegram_e2e_evidence))>0)=2
 ORDER BY q.edit_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF q SKIP LOCKED
)
UPDATE room_status_message_edits q SET state='pending',updated_at=NOW()
FROM eligible x WHERE q.edit_id=x.edit_id RETURNING 'ONE_DIAGNOSTIC_EDIT_QUEUED';"
result=$(docker exec "$db" psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -c "$sql") || exit 72
printf '%s\n' "$result" | grep -qx ONE_DIAGNOSTIC_EDIT_QUEUED || exit 73
echo ONE_TERMINAL_DIAGNOSTIC_ATTEMPT=QUEUED
sleep 32
echo SAFE_TELEGRAM_REJECTION_CLASSES_BEGIN
docker logs --since 2m deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep 'ROOM_PUBLIC_TELEGRAM_EDIT_REJECTED' | grep -E 'MESSAGE_|TELEGRAM_|NO_TELEGRAM_RESPONSE' | tail -n 3 || :
echo SAFE_TELEGRAM_REJECTION_CLASSES_END
docker exec "$db" psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -F '|' -c "SELECT e.kind,q.state,COUNT(*) FROM room_status_message_edits q JOIN room_source_events e ON e.event_id=q.room_event_id GROUP BY e.kind,q.state ORDER BY e.kind,q.state" || exit 74
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 75
echo TERMINAL_REJECTION_DIAG_EVIDENCE_COLLECTED
